design: red hoodie; white/red headscarf; silver chains; black wide cargo; large black lug boots; no glasses
resolutionRule: standing character must have >=500px visible height; crouched/airborne/lying poses preserve anatomical scale rather than being individually enlarged
cameraCalibrationNotes: Whole source groups were calibrated against the approved idle head/boot scale where generation changed camera framing. All source corrections are listed; no native enlargement or per-pose bounding-box fitting.
gameIntegration: MDEP ten-frame profile enabled; dedicated movement strips and independent FX. Latest Majis, Chapuh and Franco fork integrated. No combat rules changed.
integrationNotes: 49 strips: 19 states, 22 attacks and 8 effects. Each has ten distinct RGBA PNG cells of 768x768; strip size is 7680x768.
Nominal supporting-foot pivot is (384,700). Airborne and lying silhouettes use the documented center root. Standing rest art is approximately 563px high before the single runtime scale of 0.85.

Compact crouching, airborne and lying silhouettes are not enlarged to reach a minimum bounding-box height. Anatomical scale is calibrated per source group; no independent pose fitting or native upscaling.
SA1 and SA3 intentionally share the compatible rifle preparation/aim/recovery drawings. Actual four-shot and ten-shot events drive recoil, muzzle flash and projectile effects.
PNG cells/strips are game assets; the five contact sheets, GIFs and expression boards are previews/references only.

Native generated multi-pose source boards are not included in this delivery. Their dimensions and SHA-256 provenance remain in the inventory; all final cells, strips and generator prompts are included.
